evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: However, existing MLE benchmarks limit agents to single-file edits without full repository or shell access, and common repository-level software engineering benchmarks have rapidly saturated.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: To address this, we introduce the Code Complexity Index (CCI), a difficulty metric based on ten structural features spanning repository scale, dependency depth, and patch size.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: First, we construct BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite, the first difficulty-graded, repository-level variant of MLE-Bench Lite; across 14 evaluated models, the top solve rate drops from 95% to 9% as difficulty is scaled from the easiest to the hardest tier.
